module_summary: 10GBASE-R 64b/66b block decoder to AXI-Stream: classifies blocks into input types with lane-swap realignment, two-stage pipeline, 3-state framing FSM and LFSR CRC32 FCS check.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/LAST FSM producing AXI beats, tlast and FCS errors

anchors.name: encoded_rx_data
anchors.why: 64-bit 64b/66b block payload input decoded by block type

anchors.name: encoded_rx_hdr
anchors.why: 2-bit sync header distinguishing data versus control blocks

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: AXI-Stream output payload

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-Stream valid during PAYLOAD/LAST

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Last beat marker on terminate or error

anchors.name: m_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables derived from terminate block type

anchors.name: m_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Bad-frame flag plus optional timestamp

anchors.name: input_type_d0
anchors.why: Decoded block class (data/start/term_n/error) steering FSM and tkeep

anchors.name: input_type_d1
anchors.why: Delayed block class for start detection and LAST-state checks

anchors.name: input_data_d0
anchors.why: Aligned payload stage feeding CRC LFSR

anchors.name: input_data_d1
anchors.why: Second payload stage driving AXI tdata

anchors.name: lanes_swapped
anchors.why: Set for lane-4 start; selects 32-bit realigned data and remapped term types

anchors.name: swap_data
anchors.why: Upper half of previous block used in lane-swapped realignment

anchors.name: delay_type_valid
anchors.why: Indicates delayed block type pending for swapped lanes

anchors.name: delay_type
anchors.why: Block type deferred one cycle for lane-swapped decoding

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC32 state reset between frames

anchors.name: reset_crc
anchors.why: FSM-driven reinitialisation of CRC state

anchors.name: crc_valid
anchors.why: Per-length CRC residue matches deciding FCS good/bad

anchors.name: crc_valid_save
anchors.why: Registered CRC matches for TERM_0 and LAST-state checks

anchors.name: cfg_rx_enable
anchors.why: Enables frame acceptance on start

anchors.name: error_bad_frame
anchors.why: Pulse on framing or FCS error

anchors.name: error_bad_fcs
anchors.why: Pulse on FCS mismatch

anchors.name: rx_bad_block
anchors.why: Pulse on invalid sync header or block type

anchors.name: start_packet
anchors.why: Start-of-packet indication with lane position

anchors.name: ptp_ts_reg
anchors.why: Timestamp captured at frame start, sent in tuser

anchors.name: ts_inc_reg
anchors.why: Per-cycle timestamp increment for swapped-start correction

anchors.name: ptp_ts
anchors.why: PTP time input sampled at frame start

groups.name: Receive FSM
groups.description: Frames packets from decoded block types and checks FCS

groups.name: Block decoder and lane alignment
groups.description: Classifies 64b/66b blocks, realigns lane-4 starts, flags bad blocks

groups.name: Data pipeline
groups.description: Two-stage payload delay aligned with block types

groups.name: CRC checker
groups.description: 64-bit LFSR CRC32 with per-length residue comparison

groups.name: AXI stream output
groups.description: Registered AXI-Stream beat with keep, last and user

groups.name: Status and PTP
groups.description: Error/start status pulses and start-of-frame timestamping
